title: H1B Return to India with RSUs: Complete Tax Guide (Avoid $50K+ Penalties)
description: Comprehensive guide to RSU taxation when returning to India from H1B. Learn US vs India tax rates, DTAA benefits, Form 67 filing, capital gains treatment, and strategies to minimize dual taxation on $100K+ unvested stock compensation.
content:
## Quick Answer: H1B to India RSU Tax Treatment

**When you return to India with unvested RSUs:**

**US tax (when RSUs vest after you leave):**
- California + Federal tax on employment income (35-50% total)
- File Form 1040-NR as non-resident

**India tax:**
- Employment income taxed at 30% slab rate
- Claim foreign tax credit using Form 67
- DTAA (Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement) prevents pure double taxation

**You pay the HIGHER rate** (usually US), not both. Proper FTC claiming saves $20,000-$50,000.
